proposals.title: RAW UNREVIEWED: applying material to a physical substrate and depicting a figure produce different owned results
proposals.summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_UNTESTED_SPECULATIVE. A complete craft/content account can introduce a physical recipient, apply a material to it, and separately establish what the resulting surface represents. Later treatment of that surface must retain its physical owner; a depicted organ or figure is not automatically the patient of the operation. This is a local three-role construction, not another material-row count or free image-to-word label.

design.mechanism: Enter physical substrate S and material M; APPLY(M,S) produces a coating/state on S; DEPICTS(result,D) introduces a represented referent D. A later physical action must bind S or its applied result. A statement about D requires the explicit representation relation and cannot silently turn D into the substrate or recipient.
design.unit: Two complete already-owned contexts nominated prospectively, with every group and alternative preserved. Independent recipient/substrate/result owner evidence must be frozen before new lexical values; producer does not read target bodies.
design.contrast: Substrate-owned application plus represented referent versus action directed to the depicted body, or representation interpreted as production of the represented living/material thing.
design.prediction: Use one fixed typed grammar on both complete contexts. Independently established substrate/figure owners must bind the written recipient and result, and the later consumer must select a compatible physical role. If interpretation predicts treating a pictured body while the independent owner is an image-bearing surface, the branch fails unless an explicit paid representation-to-body relation is written. UNKNOWN intervals do not supply that bridge.
design.scope: Speculative local whole-content rival only; no image inspection, target nomination, old-model extension, topology census or claim that f88r is a painted-object account.

missing_inputs: Independent admitted primary typing and ownership of physical recipient, represented figure and any result

A complete historical representation/substrate passage checked before scientific selection; prior Cennini concepts are illustrative only
proposals.required_falsifier: Reject if the frozen whole reading requires an unlicensed DEPICTED_ENTITY-to-PHYSICAL_RECIPIENT coercion, if the result has no independent owner, or if the same fixed operation must change its argument type across the pair.
retained_caveats: 695 material/layer ownership is under root review, not independently established by this proposal.
655 meaning-binding failure and436source-architecture misattribution remain unchanged; no rescue claimed.
Cennini copy representation does not imply identity with a living model.
proposals.exact_changed_research_decision: Adds a substrate/representation whole-account rival whose recipient must be independently owned before a new lexical extension; it supplies no automatic owner or gloss.

proposals.title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a resulting condition belongs to an entered recipient while a manufactured product requires a separate object entry
proposals.summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_UNTESTED_SPECULATIVE. A complete account may administer or act on an entered recipient and then name its resulting condition, rather than create a new material product. A contrasting account manufactures an output entity and deposits or uses it. Independent recipient/result typing can distinguish these branches without assigning arbitrary disease or material names.

design.mechanism: Recipient branch: enter R, perform a written action on R, and assert RESULT_STATE(R,P,episode), with any later condition predicate still owned by R. Product branch: enter an input, perform a producing action, explicitly enter output O with provenance, and direct the later consumer to O. State ownership and produced-object identity are distinct typed results; neither is inherited from input qualities.
design.unit: Two complete already-owned contexts nominated prospectively, with every group and alternative preserved. Independent recipient/substrate/result owner evidence must be frozen before new lexical values; producer does not read target bodies.
design.contrast: Recipient-owned result state versus newly produced material/entity, with purpose-only outcome as a retained third possibility. A result-shaped nominal does not by itself prove successful change or new-object creation.
design.prediction: Freeze result sorts and all primitive values before a paired whole reading. In the state branch the written result and later condition must share an independently entered recipient and episode; in the product branch a paid output entry/provenance must supply the consumer. If only a purpose is written, neither completed result is asserted. Every group contributes or remains UNKNOWN; no automatic state/product coercion from fluent English.
design.scope: Speculative result-ownership approach only; no medical efficacy claim, new physiology/material gloss, inherited quality, latest-nominal fallback or repeat portion/result census.

missing_inputs: Complete prospective paired contexts with candidate action/result/later-consumer contributions
Independent typed recipient and result ownership from already admitted evidence
Written distinction among result-state assertion, produced-output entry and mere purpose
Verified complete historical clauses for the proposed result sorts before scientific selection
proposals.required_falsifier: Reject if recipient state is supplied only by an unentered owner, if output identity is invented from a result noun, if a purpose becomes an achieved result without a written assertion, or if fixed result typing cannot consume the whole second context.
retained_caveats: 565 recipient-conditioned construction remains nonconfirming;343/344complete-target gaps stay open.

proposals.exact_changed_research_decision: Offers independently owned recipient state as a whole-account alternative to deposited material output; selection requires a written result owner and consumer rather than another noun gloss.
